relations.text: コミナティはビオンテックと共同で開発・販売している
relations.text_en: Comirnaty is jointly developed and commercialized with BioNTech

source.label: Pfizer Inc. 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: Comirnaty is an mRNA-based coronavirus vaccine to help prevent COVID-19, which is jointly developed and commercialized with BioNTech.

relations.text: VLA15をバルネバと共同で開発中だ
relations.text_en: VLA15 is being developed in collaboration with Valneva

source.label: Pfizer Inc. 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: (c) VLA15 is being developed in collaboration with Valneva SE.

relations.text: アドセトリスは武田薬品と協力して開発・販売される
relations.text_en: Adcetris is being developed and commercialized in collaboration with Takeda

source.label: Pfizer Inc. 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: Adcetris (bren tuximab vedotin) is being developed and commercialized in collaboration with Takeda.

relations.text: ティブダクはゲンマブと協力して販売している
relations.text_en: Tivdak is commercialized in collaboration with Genmab

source.label: Pfizer Inc. 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: Tivdak (tisotumab vedotin-tftv) is commercialized in collaboration with Genmab.

relations.text: ベペデグストラントはアービナスと共同で開発中だ
relations.text_en: Vepdegestrant is being developed in collaboration with Arvinas

source.label: Pfizer Inc. 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: Vepdegestrant is being developed in collaboration with Arvinas.

relations.text: 分離後もビアトリスと互いの製品を製造・包装し合う契約がある
relations.text_en: Under the MSAs, each company manufactures, labels and packages products for the other

source.label: Pfizer Inc. 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: Under the MSAs, Pfizer or Viatris, as the case may be, manufactures, labels and packages products for the other party.
